artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: parse_scope accepts SCOPE_DIMENSIONS, or SCOPE_DIMENSIONS plus the optional PORTAL_DIMENSION 'portal_channels' (a non-empty list of channel ids matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$). With a non-empty portal_channels, masters, datasets, accounts and columns may all be empty together (a portal-only grant). A partly-empty Schwab half, or a Schwab half that is empty with no or empty portal_channels, goes to the unchanged strict parse and is Malformed. A record without the key parses exactly as before. Scope gains portal_channels (default frozenset()) and a portal_only property; allowed_tools returns frozenset() for a portal-only grant. Not deployed: the deploy is OA-g-2.

EffectiveScope gains portal_channels, which passes through with the rest and collapses to empty with it. In handle_asker_query, after the calling identity's catalog_gate verdict passes and before any fetch: if the asker's grant carries portal_channels, the key is served only when verdict.row['_channel'] is a granted channel. Otherwise the tool returns _denial('asker_channel_denied', ...), the same deny shape, audited as DENY-CHANNEL. Docstring points (c) and (d) are amended. A grant without portal_channels takes the unchanged path.

validate_candidate(raw, contract, catalog_channels=None) rejects portal_channels (CandidateRejected) when the contract has no portal_grant with scope_dimension 'portal_channels', or when a channel is not one the catalog holds. The held channels come from load_catalog_channels(), which reads app/refs/DATA_CATALOG.yaml through catalog_gate.load_catalog and fails closed. prepare() passes catalog_channels through. scope_diff/format_diff carry portal_channels. _scope_to_raw writes portal_channels only when it is carried, so a Schwab-only grant keeps its v1.1 record shape.

contract_version 1.1 -> 1.2. A new top-level portal_grant block (placed after grant_date_modes) holds: scope_dimension 'portal_channels', optional true, and absent_means (the record parses as v1.1). It names channel_catalog infra/aws/ec2/opal-gateway/app/refs/DATA_CATALOG.yaml; channel_ids are the channels.* keys that catalog_gate indexes. empty_when_portal_channels lists masters/accounts/datasets/columns, with empty_rule 'only together and only beside a non-empty portal_channels; empty of both is malformed'. The block also sets portal_only_schwab_tools [], served_by opal_asker_query and store 'the same data_entitlement POLICY record; no second grant store'. No other key changed. integrations/schwab/catalog.py parse_contract ignores unknown keys, and nothing in the gateway reads contract_version.

The six named tests use injected stores, an injected STS client, a monkeypatched query_v0._fetch_capped and the real DATA_CATALOG.yaml. Two servable channels are derived from the live catalog, never typed. The refusal test first asserts that the calling identity's own gate WOULD serve the other-channel key, so the refusal is the asker grant's alone. The file does not contain the string the checks grep for.
